capabilities: apply one of 12 animated graph presets
select the preset in plugin settings
toggle the effect on and off with a command
extras: The README warns the animated graph may spin up your fans because the plugin has little control over the graph backend; settings selection is mentioned but the two preview images are not described in detail.
intentEvidence: A for-fun plugin for Obsidian that brings the graph to life.
motivation: The author describes it as for-fun, built to bring the graph to life.
problem: Obsidian's graph view is static in presentation, with no built-in way to animate or restyle its physics parameters.
summary: Graph-view tweak plugin that applies 12 animated presets to make the Obsidian graph view move and feel alive.
